description: Plan readiness review (#2016). Answers whether execution can safely start from this plan. Declares no compare-baseline step because a first plan has nothing to regress against; that choice is recorded in flows/intents/plan-readiness.intent.json.

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Upstream requirements the plan must satisfy. Optional: absence degrades the cross-artifact step rather than stopping the Flow.

inputs.name: design
inputs.description: Design document the plan derives from. Optional: absence skips the design cross-check.

steps.description: Existing upstream-phase selection; no Flow-local skill list.
Plan against requirements. Runs unconditionally; without requirements it degrades to a plan-internal review and records the degradation.
